summary: CAMP4 Therapeutics furnished a Form 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 on September 28, 2026, disclosing an Analyst Day presentation concerning its planned Phase 1/2 ASCEND trial of CMP-002 in SYNGAP1-related disorder. The registrant, a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical issuer, provided trial design details: a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled multiple ascending dose study with 3:1 randomization to intrathecal CMP-002 or sham, three cohorts of at least eight participants aged 2 to under 18. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are stated. The filing is a routine product-development disclosure, not a special situation.
